text.offer: Cital wants you to fight the avars' warriors. I say cut out their magic first. Their shamans heal the warriors and curse our people. Ten of them, and the warriors fall all the easier.
text.progress: The avar shamans keep to the camps and the ruins of the Riija temple, in the deep jungle.
text.complete: No more healing for the avars, not for a while. You're useful. I like useful.
